glossary.definition: (A) "Adult" means a person who is eighteen years of age or older.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Capacity to consent to mental health treatment decisions" means the functional ability to understand information about the risks of, benefits of, and alternatives to the proposed mental health treatment, to rationally use that information, to appreciate how that information applies to the declarant, and to express a choice about the proposed treatment.
glossary.normalized: capacity to consent to mental health treatment decisions
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.
glossary.term: Capacity to consent to mental health treatment decisions

glossary.definition: (C) "Declarant" means an adult who has executed a declaration for mental health treatment in accordance with this chapter.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Declaration for mental health treatment" or "declaration" means a written document declaring preferences or instructions regarding mental health treatment executed in accordance with this chapter.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Declaration for mental health treatment" or "declaration" means a written document declaring preferences or instructions regarding mental health treatment executed in accordance with this chapter.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Designated physician" means the physician the declarant has named in a declaration for mental health treatment and has assigned the primary responsibility for the declarant's mental health treatment or, if the declarant has not so named a physician, the physician who has accepted that responsibility.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Guardian" means a person appointed by a probate court pursuant to Chapter 2111. of the Revised Code to have the care and management of the person of an incompetent.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (G) "Health care" means any care, treatment, service, or procedure to maintain, diagnose, or treat an individual's physical or mental condition or physical or mental health.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Health care facility" has the same meaning as in section 1337.11 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (I) "Incompetent" has the same meaning as in section 2111.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (J) "Informed consent" means consent voluntarily given by a person after a sufficient explanation and disclosure of the subject matter involved to enable that person to have a general understanding of the nature, purpose, and goal of the treatment or procedures, including the substantial risks and hazards inherent in the proposed treatment or procedures and any alternative treatment or procedures, and to make a knowing health care decision without coercion or undue influence.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (K) "Medical record" means any document or combination of documents that pertains to a declarant's medical history, diagnosis, prognosis, or medical condition and that is generated and maintained in the process of the declarant's health care.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (L) "Mental health treatment" means any care, treatment, service, or procedure to maintain, diagnose, or treat an individual's mental condition or mental health, including, but not limited to, electroconvulsive or other convulsive treatment, treatment of mental illness with medication, and admission to and retention in a health care facility.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (M) "Mental health treatment decision" means informed consent, refusal to give informed consent, or withdrawal of informed consent to mental health treatment.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (N) "Mental health treatment provider" means physicians, physician assistants, psychologists, licensed independent social workers, licensed professional clinical counselors, and psychiatric nurses.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (O) "Physician" means a person who is authorized under Chapter 4731. of the Revised Code to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (P) "Professional disciplinary action" means action taken by the board or other entity that regulates the professional conduct of health care personnel, including, but not limited to, the state medical board, the state board of psychology, and the state board of nursing.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (Q) "Proxy" means an adult designated to make mental health treatment decisions for a declarant under a valid declaration for mental health treatment.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (R) "Psychiatric nurse" means a registered nurse who holds a master's degree or doctorate in nursing with a specialization in psychiatric nursing.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (S) "Psychiatrist" has the same meaning as in section 5122.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (T) "Psychologist" has the same meaning as in section 4732.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition: (U) "Registered nurse" has the same meaning as in section 4723.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2135.01 to 2135.15 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2135.01 - Declaration for mental health treatment definitions.

glossary.definition:
(V) "Tort action" means a civil action for damages for injury, death, or loss to person or property, other than a civil action for damages for a breach of contract or another agreement between persons.
